Tuesday, October 1, 2024 3:05 PM To: Hailey Miller <hmille45@jhu.edu> Subject: Re. the diet quality for adults with hypertension project External Email - Use Caution Dear Hailey, I hope you are doing well. I wanted to follow up on my previous email regarding our collaboration on the diet quality for adults with hypertension project, and the value Avicenna can bring to your team. We already have worked with more than 3,000 researchers from more than 100 universities, and we consistently see using an app for participants as part of the research leads to higher participant retention, more engagement, and higher data quality. That's why I genuinely believe our tool could greatly contribute to your upcoming research as well. You can learn more about our work in this Google Sheets file. Please let me know if you are available for a brief chat or demo, and what time might work for you in the following days. Also if you don't want to hear from me, just reply and let me know. Warm regards, Amin P.S: I include my initial email just in case you've missed it: Dear Dr. Miller, My name is Amin from Avicenna Research, a Canadian health-research software company. I just came across your recent project focused on leveraging grocery delivery services to enhance adherence to the DASH eating pattern among adults with hypertension, and its successful NINR grant. Congratulations! That certainly speaks to the value and importance of your research. I am reaching out to explore any potential collaboration opportunities, as I genuinely believe we can help you with this study. We enable researchers to quickly set up participant-facing apps and websites for health and psychology studies. Specifically, Avicenna can support this project in the following ways: Simplifying the consent process and assessing eligibility criteria via the app Presenting educational content, surveys, and experience sampling to participants through the app Collecting sensor data from smartphones or wearables to help monitor physical activity and other related health parameters Providing personalized feedback and goal-setting interventions directly through the app Enhancing participant motivation and retention via gamified elements and progress tracking Facilitating participant communication with health coaches or researchers via the app’s televisit or messaging features Integrating tailored grocery lists and grocery delivery options into the app to improve dietary adherence Capturing and analyzing real-time data to assess intervention efficacy and participant adherence Here you can find our slide deck with more details on our software. We have worked with many teams on dietary interventions across different demographics, and its impact on health (check our publication track record here). That, plus the fact we have done multiple projects with your colleagues at JHU, makes me confident that we can bring value to your research as well. Would you be open to scheduling a brief call or a demo to discuss this further? You can check my calendar here and pick a time that works best for you. Thank you for your valuable time, and looking forward to hearing your reply. Best, Amin -------- Amin Tavassolian ( My Calendar) Solutions Architect Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data) 4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: amin.tavassolian@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com------
